sourceLabel: NOVA Hospitality F&B Lunch & Dinner Recipe Books

recipes.name: Beef Satay
recipes.preparationMethod: Marinate the beef, thread onto skewers and grill. Fry the chips and serve with salad and peanut sauce.

recipes.name: Beef Samosa
recipes.preparationMethod: Cook the seasoned beef filling, fill the pastry, fold and deep-fry until golden. Serve with salad.

recipes.name: Vegetable Samosa
recipes.preparationMethod: Cook the vegetable filling, fill the pastry, fold and deep-fry until golden. Serve with salad.

recipes.name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
recipes.preparationMethod: Stir-fry the filling briefly, roll in wrappers and fry until crisp. Serve with salad.

recipes.name: Guacamole with Tortillas
recipes.preparationMethod: Mash avocado with lime, onion, tomato and coriander. Season and serve with tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Oven-Roasted Cashew Nuts
recipes.preparationMethod: Toss cashews with oil, salt and paprika; roast at 170°C until lightly golden.

recipes.name: Cheese and Tomato Sandwich
recipes.preparationMethod: Fill bread with cheese, tomato and onion; toast until crisp. Serve with garlic chips and cocktail sauce.

recipes.name: Hot Dog
recipes.preparationMethod: Grill or heat the sausage, place in the bun with onion and sauces. Serve with chips and mixed salad.

recipes.name: NOVA Cheeseburger
recipes.preparationMethod: Season and grill the beef patty, melt cheese on top and assemble in the bun. Serve with chips and salad.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken
recipes.preparationMethod: Season and grill the chicken until fully cooked. Serve with chips and coleslaw.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
recipes.preparationMethod: Spread tomato sauce on the base, add mozzarella and basil, then bake at 230°C until crisp.

recipes.name: Salami Pizza
recipes.preparationMethod: Spread tomato sauce on the base, add mozzarella and salami, then bake at 230°C.

recipes.name: Chicken Pizza
recipes.preparationMethod: Spread tomato sauce on the base, add mozzarella, cooked chicken, pepper and onion, then bake at 230°C.

recipes.name: Herbal Salad with Shredded Chicken
recipes.preparationMethod: Arrange greens and vegetables, add shredded chicken and toss lightly with oriental dressing.

recipes.name: Vegan Herbal Garden Salad
recipes.preparationMethod: Arrange greens, avocado, sun-dried tomato, olives, capers and mango; add lemon-honey dressing.

recipes.name: Herbal Garden Salad with Crispy Bacon
recipes.preparationMethod: Arrange greens and vegetables, add crisp bacon and serve with garlic mayonnaise.

recipes.name: Oriental Chicken Puff Pastry
recipes.preparationMethod: Fill pastry with cooked Oriental chicken, seal and bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Seasonal Fruit Plate
recipes.preparationMethod: Wash, peel and cut the available seasonal fruits. Arrange neatly and serve chilled.

recipes.name: Triple Ice Cream
recipes.preparationMethod: Place three scoops in a chilled dessert bowl and garnish as desired.

recipes.name: Chocolate Brownie with Toffee Sauce
recipes.preparationMethod: Bake the brownie mixture, cool and portion. Warm before serving with toffee sauce.
